title: Bag Slots
prompt_text: # Bag Slots: Glass Slot-Machine Bag Reveal Story (exact recreation prompt) Build a single-file, interactive, vertical 9:16 social-media story for a fictional bag brand, **LUNE**. A young woman in a cropped indigo denim jacket stands against a grey studio wall. A frosted-glass panel floats across her chest, reading "L U N E". When you tap the glass, she reaches toward the camera with her hand, grabs the glass and pulls it down like a slot-machine lever. That plays from a real video clip. The panel then becomes three slot reels of shoulder bags that spin with motion blur and stop one by one on three matching bags. Then: 1. The glass melts away and the two side bags slide out. 2. The centre bag grows over her chest. 3. The frame washes out to white and holds as a clean packshot (with swatches that recolour the bag). 4. Hard cut to a black card with the small "L U N E" wordmark. 5. Tapping it cuts her back to the start (hidden behind the black card) and she pulls again. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, with no libraries. Every value below is exact. Reproduce every string, number, timing and URL as written. --- ## 1. Page basics - ``, title `Bag Slots`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`, charset utf-8. - **Font (Google Fonts):** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap`, with preconnects to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the three latin woff2 faces as base64 `@font-face` rules instead of the link. - **Variables:** `--ink:#16161a`, `--glass:rgba(255,255,255,.14)`, `--edge:rgba(255,255,255,.42)`. - **Reset and base:** - Universal `box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0`. - `html,body` fill the height, `overflow:hidden`, background `#cfd0cf`. - body font `"Inter","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif`, ink colour, antialiased, `user-select:none`. ## 2. Assets (all URLs exact) 1. **Her clip (Kling 4.0 reference-to-video, 5.04 s, 24 fps, 1080×1920, no audio).** It was generated with our model image as the start and the original campaign's reach-and-pull segment as the motion reference. - She stands with her arms down. - She reaches up toward the camera with her right hand (screen left) at chest height and leans in. - About 1.72 s: she grabs an invisible panel. - About 2.05 s: she pulls it down. - She then straightens, puts her hands behind her back, tilts her head and waits. `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261106_073138_ef13b890-f508-46d7-bf25-278d3144c3d5.mp4` 2. **White bag cut-out (transparent PNG, 1:1):** an original small structured baguette shoulder bag in plain white leather, with a slim front flap, a small gold ring clasp and a thin curved single strap on gold rings. Front view, no logo. `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_072459_3a7afc56-a581-4651-8e7e-756e12183786.png&w=900&q=88` **Colours:** | # | Name | Hex | |---|---|---| | 0 | Lilac | `#b9a8ef` | | 1 | Butter | `#f2dfa8` | | 2 | Sage | `#8cc27a` | | 3 | Tangerine | `#f29a52` | | 4 | Rose | `#ee88b6` | | 5 | Ink | `#3a3a44` | | 6 | Sky | `#9ccff0` | **One tinted bag (`.bag`):** a relative box holding two full-size layers: - `.t`: background `var(--c)`, masked by the bag image (`mask: var(--m) center/contain no-repeat`, with a `-webkit-` prefix too). - The white bag ``: `object-fit:contain`, `mix-blend-mode:multiply`. This turns the one white bag into any colour while keeping its leather shading. ## 3. Story canvas - **Story `#story`:** absolutely centred (translate -50%,-50%), overflow hidden, background `#d4d5d3`. - On load and resize: `w = min(innerWidth, innerHeight·9/16)`, height `w·16/9`, and `font-size w/100` px, so **1em = 1% of the story width**. - **Canvas `#cv`:** fills the story. - **Hidden clip `
